before the player can merge the Dragon Banner and progress the main quest.
Controls how many focus points and attribute points the logic requires for each skill level location.
Soft: based on the game's Learning Limit. Past the learning limit you will start to receive negative modifiers to xp, but those locations past this are reachable
Medium: the middle ground between soft and hard. Slight experience penalties will occur on this option
Hard: based on the point at which skills can no longer be gained. Experience penalties for skills close to the cap are ~30x slower than experience gain below the learning limit

THIS IS NOT AN EASY GOAL, BE FOREWARNED
When enabled, upgrading minor faction's troops will be required for troopSanity,
Minor factions include Vakken and Darshi, as well as factions like Children of the Woods, Eleftheroi, Skolderbroda, and Company of the Golden Boar
This will require targeted attacks against these factions, capturing prisoners, and then keeping them alive long enough to upgrade them.
These troops will still have items in the archipelago to be able to recruit/upgrade them regardless of whether you have this option enabled.
When enabled, upgrading bandit's troops will be required for troopSanity,
Bandit factions include various bandit types like Forest Bandits, Mountain Bandits, and Desert Bandits.
This will require capturing prisoners, recruting bandits, and then keeping them alive long enough to upgrade them.
These troops will still have items in the archipelago to be able to recruit/upgrade them regardless of whether you have this option enabled.
When enabled, upgrading mercenary's troops will be required for troopSanity,
This will require either capturing mercenaries as prisoners, or hiring them directly and upgrading from the lowest to the highest tier.
These troops will still have items in the archipelago to be able to recruit/upgrade them regardless of whether you have this option enabled.
